What I bring

Full-stack development backed by DevOps and systems thinking.

I recently built and deployed MediaVault, a full-stack media storage application using React, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, Prisma, JWT authentication, private Amazon S3 storage, presigned URLs, Vercel, Railway, Route 53, and Amazon SES.

Before that, during my DevOps apprenticeship, I worked with engineering and QA teams to improve release processes for React Native iOS and Android applications. I supported CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Fastlane, and Bash, resolved environment and build issues, and helped teams deliver stable releases.

Flagship project Full-stack application

MediaVault

A production-deployed application for securely organizing photos and videos with private cloud storage, protected albums, and authenticated user access.

  • Built the complete media workflow—from uploads and album organization to favorites, moves, and deletion.
  • Designed a React frontend, Node/Express API, and PostgreSQL/Prisma data layer with JWT authentication.
  • Deployed across Vercel, Railway, and AWS using private S3 storage and presigned URLs.

Cloud Infrastructure Project

Terraform-based AWS infrastructure for a secure, multi-environment static website with automated delivery, monitoring, and alerting.

  • Provisioned S3, CloudFront, Route 53, ACM, IAM, CloudWatch, and SNS with reusable Terraform configuration.
  • Created separate development and production environments with remote, versioned Terraform state.
  • Implemented GitHub Actions deployments using OIDC instead of long-lived AWS credentials.
